verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Genie answering natural-language data questions grounded in the organization's data. It returns SQL queries, results tables and visualizations, and runs on web and mobile for business users. Genie Code adds inline suggestions and agentic data work against Unity Catalog tables, and AI/BI dashboards support AI-assisted authoring. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI answers and insights are accurate and useful; explicit documentation of proactive, automatically surfaced insights from data (such as anomaly or trend detection) beyond question-and-answer and authoring assistance.
